Clause text: This agreement automatically renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice.
The subscription shall renew automatically at the end of each annual period.
Unless cancelled thirty days before expiry, this contract will renew for another twelve months.
The service agreement renews automatically for consecutive six-month periods.
At the end of the initial term, the agreement shall automatically extend for one additional year.
The contract will continue on a rolling basis unless a party submits a cancellation notice.
Renewal will occur automatically unless the customer opts out before the renewal date.
The parties agree that this licence renews annually unless written notice is received.
The subscription period will be extended automatically for another term of equal length.
Either party must provide notice before the renewal date to prevent automatic extension.
Either party may terminate this agreement by giving thirty days written notice.
The customer may end the service at any time by written notice.
A party may terminate the contract if the other party materially breaches its obligations.
This agreement may be terminated immediately following an uncured material breach.
Either party can end the agreement for convenience with sixty days notice.
The provider may suspend services before termination if payment remains overdue.
Upon termination, each party must return the other party's confidential information.
The agreement ends automatically when the project is completed.
A party may terminate this contract if the other party becomes insolvent.
Termination notices must be sent in writing to the other party.
A late payment fee will apply to invoices that remain unpaid after the due date.
The customer must pay a cancellation fee if the booking is cancelled late.
Early termination will incur a charge equal to three months of service fees.
A penalty will be charged for each day delivery is delayed.
The supplier may impose a fee for returned payments.
The customer shall pay liquidated damages for failure to meet the agreed deadline.
A fixed charge applies when the customer cancels after work has started.
Overdue accounts may be subject to an additional late fee.
The contract specifies a charge for failing to meet the service-level target.
The buyer must pay the stated cancellation charge when cancelling without sufficient notice.
The provider has unlimited liability for all damages arising under this agreement.
Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential losses.
The supplier's total liability is capped at the fees paid during the previous twelve months.
The customer accepts responsibility for all losses caused by its misuse of the service.
The provider shall indemnify the customer against third-party claims.
Liability for data loss is excluded to the fullest extent permitted by law.
Each party's liability shall not exceed the total contract value.
The supplier is responsible for damages caused by its negligence.
No financial cap applies to the provider's liability under this clause.
The parties exclude liability for loss of anticipated profits.
Invoices must be paid within thirty days of receipt.
Payment is due within fifteen days after the invoice date.
The customer shall pay the monthly subscription fee in advance.
All payments must be made by bank transfer.
The supplier will issue an invoice at the end of each month.
Interest may apply to overdue payments.
The first payment is due before services commence.
The customer must pay all undisputed invoices by the stated due date.
Fees shall be paid in accordance with the schedule in Appendix A.
The provider may pause services if an invoice remains unpaid.
Each party must keep confidential information received from the other party secure.
The recipient shall not disclose confidential information to third parties without consent.
Confidential information may only be used to perform obligations under this agreement.
The confidentiality obligation continues for three years after termination.
Each party must protect trade secrets using reasonable safeguards.
Disclosure is permitted when required by applicable law.
Employees who access confidential information must be bound by confidentiality duties.
The receiving party shall promptly report any unauthorised disclosure.
Confidential materials must be returned or destroyed upon request.
The parties agree not to publish the other party's confidential business information.
The provider will deliver a monthly service report to the customer.
The service will be available from Monday to Friday.
The parties will meet quarterly to discuss project progress.
The customer may request a demonstration before implementation.
The supplier will provide onboarding documentation to the customer.
The project is expected to begin after the kickoff meeting.
The parties will cooperate in good faith during implementation.
The service includes standard technical support during business hours.
The provider will maintain a record of completed work.
Project milestones are listed in Schedule One.
